5.message: Incredible! The 2-hour ride with 3 landings is the way to go. Incredible photos and we did the 10:15 am flight which was beautiful in brightness. We rented a car to the lodge and that ride was gorgeous too! Cody was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable about the glaciers and was super chill. A true highlight for our first day in Alaska..

Dit was een TOP belevenis in superlatieven!Zeer goede piloot die veel uitleg gaf.We vlogen laag boven de grond,soms zigzaggend tussen kloven en deden meerdere stopplaatsen aan,telkens anders.We voelden ons alleen op de wereld in een betoverend landschap!
It was absolutely amazing! One of the best things I’ve did in my life! Great Guide and driver!

Esperienza fantastica, unica Personale accogliente e preciso, puntuale Pilota eccezionale, disponibile, professionale oltre che gentile. Nonostante l’incomprensione della lingua ci ha supportato e stupidì ad ogni tappa del percorso
Better than I could have imagined, well worth every penny. Sam was great, very knowledgeable and amiable. I’m looking forward to my next tour.
Excelente a la altura de lo esperado, el precio un poco alto …
Geweldige helikoptervlucht gehad met 3 stops. Veel uitleg en zeer relaxt Een onvergetelijke trip!

Awesome! Landed next to Lake George glacier wall, then an overlook over Colony glacier (with edible blueberries on the ground), then on the Knik glacier, walked on it using crampons, and drinking some glacier water. Helicopter can carry up to 3 passengers which was perfect for my family of 3. Christian was our pilot and he was awesome with flying, knowledge, and taking pics for us. Of course I was concerned about the price, but have no regrets after doing it. Definite must do!
